We prove the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm for output tracking of the nonlinear controlled system and give the convergence conditions. Simulation results show that the closed-loop ILC algorithm is more stable than the open-loop ILC algorithm. Compared with the iterative learning control under the classical local Lipschitz condition, the improved algorithm under one-sided Lipschitz and quadratic inner-bounded conditions decrease the constraint condition of the iterative learning control on the controlled system.

articleTitle: Taffic identification model based on Convolutional Neural Network — CON-BSCNN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In today's complex connected network environment, any abnormal network attack may cause serious problems, ranging from loss of data to great economic and social losses. How to distinguish normal traffic and abnormal attack traffic by analyzing the characteristics of network traffic has become the focus of network security research, among which the anomaly detection system is a very important branch. At present, neural network has been widely used in anomaly detection. Most studies combine CNN and LSTM structure to extract spatiotemporal characteristics of network traffic to classify abnormal traffic. However, when LSTM is used for high-dimensional original traffic data, the gradient will disappear, and the training process is complex and time-consuming. Therefore, based on the convolutional neural network CNN, this paper proposes a model CONBSCNN with global feature correlation ability. This paper proposes the CON structure and combines it with the BSCNN structure to form the CONBSCNN model. This network model can fully learn the interaction protocol characteristics and timing information characteristics of traffic. Compared with the traditional BSCNN, the classification accuracy of UNSW-NB15, KDDCUP99 and as well as the encrypted traffic data collected by ourselves has been improved, and the accuracy of KDD data sets is 99.9%. In addition, CON structure is added to other CNN models, and the recognition accuracy is also improved effectively. This is a 2% improvement on both datasets.

articleTitle: Self-supervised Domain Adaptation for Satellite Imagery Classification via Representation Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Hyperspectral image (HSI) classification has been attracting widespread attention in the field of computer vision and achieved remarkable results due to the rapid development of deep learning. All existing HSI classification models are based on a closed set assumption where both the training and testing data are drawn from a known common domain. However, since the satellite imagery covers an extremely vast area, it is almost impossible to guarantee the representativeness of the training samples. To tackle the aforementioned problem, we propose a self-supervised domain adaptation model that recognizes the instances coming from unknown classes while maintaining accuracy on known classes. First, we employ a novel neighborhood representation learning to learn a discriminative representation in an unsupervised way. Second, we utilize an entropy separation loss to either match each target instance with a source prototype, or reject it as “unknown”. Experiments on multiple HSI benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Influence of The Inspection and Replacement Technology of The Step and Its Related Components on The Safe Operation of Escalator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: As escalators are being used more and more, their safety becomes more and more important. This paper mainly analyzes the impact of the inspection and replacement technology of escalator and its related components on the safe operation of escalator, and draws the corresponding conclusions. By investigating the inspection and replacement technology of the step, step shaft and step roller in the process of escalator maintenance, the influence on the failure of escalator is analyzed. Study found that at the same time, based on the existing technology, should also increase the step support structure detection method and the service life of the requirements, increase the step operation level and the straightness of the requirements of the steprequirement extremum chain extension of the content, to increase the service life of the roller requirements in order to reduce the probability of the accident. Through the analysis of the normal operating conditions of escalator, it is found that the load on the upper curve part of the passenger carrying branch of escalator is the largest, so the inspection and replacement frequency of the upper curve part of the passenger carrying branch of escalator should be strengthened to prevent the damage of the ladder due to the longtime of high load operation. It has important guiding significance to improve the maintenance level of escalator and the safety of escalator operation.

articleTitle: A case study of industrial data analysis: Gearbox temperature prediction of wind turbines using ensemble deep learning regression
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The damage and effectiveness of gearboxes may directly lead to the shutdown of wind turbines (WTs) and increase the unplanned maintenance cost. The variation and distribution of gearbox temperature can reflect its working condition. The predicting gearbox temperature has emerged as an essential method for guaranteeing the safety, availability, and efficiency of WTs. A method called ensemble deep learning regression (EDLR) is proposed for gearbox temperature prediction. Using random forest method, the collected features are then selected as main impacting features. Long short-term memory is sequentially employed for the temperature prediction. The proposed approach is investigated with real data from a wind farm. The experimental results reveal that EDLR has excellent regression performance in terms of the adopted criteria and that it can accurately predict the gearbox temperature.

articleTitle: CT and MRI image fusion based on weight difference between L1 and L2 norm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: MRI and CT image fusion, which combines the features of MRI and CT images to obtain high quality images, is a significant domain. In this paper, a novel image fusion algorithm based on the weight difference between L1 and L2 norm and tight wavelet frame is presented. We first proposed the fusion model of MRI and CT images, and then proposed to apply alternate multiplier method to solve the model. Experiments show that both CT and T1-weighted MRI, CT and T2-weighted MRI, or CT and PD-weighted MRI, our proposed algorithm can achieve balance in the source images and obtain the fusion image with the best effect, which will be beneficial to help doctors make accurate diagnosis.

articleTitle: A new algorithm for generating high-speed microwave landing signals
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In this paper, based on the basic characteristics of microwave, a new method of generating microwave landing signal is presented in the form of fourth power creatively using Gaussian beam generation method, which is commonly used in microwave generation method. The Gaussian microwave landing signal generated by the new algorithm in this paper can make the pulse scan in the baseband phase of the signal to meet the requirements of the international civil aviation convention. Compared with the conventional Gaussian microwave beam generation method previously adopted, the new algorithm proposed in this paper is simpler and more effective in the actual application and operation process, and can greatly save development resources, which provides a better scheme reference for the generation of microwave landing signal in engineering practice.

articleTitle: Study on Phrase-Window-based Annotation Rules and an Identification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Word segmentation is heavily used during grammatical dependency analysis in Natural Language Processing. Most of the analysis uses the end-to-end deep learning method based on supervised learning. There are two main issues in this method: firstly, complicated annotation rules result in considerable annotation difficulties and a large workload; secondly, the algorithm cannot identify the multi-granular and diverse features of language. To solve these two issues, we propose phrase-window-based annotation rules and design the Syntax Window Model. Considering phrases as the minimum units, the annotation rules classify sentences into seven categories of nestable phrases and mark the syntactic dependencies between the phrases at the same time. Syntax Window Model, which draws ideas from the Target Detection in Computer Vision, can identify the starting and ending positions of various phrases in sentences, and simultaneously recognize nested phrases and syntactic dependencies. The results show that the annotation rules can be used easily without ambiguity. Compared with the end-to-end algorithm, the algorithm is more suitable for the multi-granularity and diversity in grammar. Experiments on Chinese Phrase Window Dataset (CPWD) using our algorithm improved accuracy by about one percent when compared with the end-to-end method. The model was applied to a CCL2018 competition, and won first place in the analysis of Chinese emotion metaphors.

articleTitle: Codec Network for Speech Bandwidth Extension
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In order to further improve the performance of speech bandwidth extension, this paper proposes an end-to-end codec network model for speech bandwidth extension. It is modeled on the time-domain waveform and consists of encoder network, long short-term memory (LSTM) and decoder network. The encoder network is responsible for feature extraction and data dimensionality reduction of the input data, the LSTM is responsible for extracting the context-dependent information of the speech signal, and the decoder network is responsible for wideband speech reconstruction of the potential features output by the LSTM. In addition, this paper also proposes a time-frequency perception loss function to guide model training to generate more accurate time-domain waveforms and more realistic frequency-domain spectrum. Experimental results show that the reconstructed wideband speech generated by the model achieves better results in both subjective and objective evaluation.

articleTitle: Prophet model with AHP: A study of the evolution of Music
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Music is part of human society and an essential part of cultural heritage. With the development of the new era, Music has also evolved. When an artist creates a new piece of Music, many factors can affect them. From these data, it may become an important research topic to determine whether features may mean a revolution in music evolution and which artists can represent revolutionaries in the future. Therefore, based on the data_by_year, full_music_data, and Impact-data data sets provided by the Integrated Music Association (ICM), our team uses the Prophet algorithm to detect mutation points, monitors their changes regularly, and reflects the revolutionary interval of music development through the location of the mutation points. The three detected mutation points were 1949, 1974, and 2000. And define the standard level index as follows: filter music by genre and year, and establish groups based on four indicators to quantify the group's influence: total popularity, average popularity, number of group music and number of groups, and impact influencers by force Perform ranking. We believe that this sequence can reveal reformers in the development of Music. Finally, we conduct decision-making analysis through AHP, obtain the final influence score and determine the three most influential artists (Foo Fighters, David Bowie, Korn) as reformers.

articleTitle: Distributionally Robust Binary Probit Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Binary probit regression is a typical model for classification problems. This paper proposes a novel distributionally robust method to estimate the parameters in binary probit regression model. We adopt the Wasserstein metric to establish the ambugity set of real distributions centered at the uniform distribution. If the size of ambugity and some hyperparameter are chosen judiciously, our distributionally robust binary probit regression model may perform well. We also discuss the tractable reformulation of the distributionally robust binary probit model and its out-of-sample performance guarantees. All results are shown in numerical experiments on UCI adult data.

articleTitle: Research on State Estimation of Outdoor Mobile Robot Based on Multiple Sensor Combination
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Multi-sensor information fusion technology is the core technology to achieve accurate and reliable vehicle positioning. For the selection of sensor types and quantities, this article proposes a variety of combinations. Through the extended Kalman filter algorithm, many experiments were carried out to analyze different results and their reasons, and obtain the state estimation effect of different sensor combinations in outdoor situations. This test provides a certain test result reference for future outdoor automatic driving technology.

articleTitle: Towards Big Data Analytics in the Online Brushing System’s Model Design
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The potential for big data analytics to improve social work students' professional qualities in a more in-depth dimension is tremendous. However, the application of big data in it is at a nascent stage. This research provides an online brushing system's model design with the data sources and methods that towards big data analytics, and describes operation interfaces, including programming brushing module and knowledge brushing module. The practice shows that big data will fulfil its potential as an important role in a quality-expanding system; also, it provides a view to dynamically extend and integrate modules considering the changing demands.

articleTitle: SiamKey: Siamese Local Keypoints Matching Network for Visual Tracking
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Siamese Network has been widely researched in the tracking framework due to its simple structure and easy expansion. Most Siamese-based Network trackers use a depthwise cross-correlation (DW-XCorr) to embed the template information into the search branch. However, this method has many limitations in Siamese Network. On the one hand, the size of template needs to be set in advance. If pre-fixed size is larger than actual target size, lots of background noise will be brought in. On the contrary, there will be losing lots of foreground information. On the other hand, DW-XCorr is a handcrafted region-based correlation module, and lots of background information will be brought in and overwhelms the feature of the target, making it hard to distinguish the target from similar objects in background. In order to solve above problems, this paper proposes a simple local keypoints matching network (SiamKey) implementing keypoint-based correlation. We select top-K keypoints of illumination and rotation invariance from template feature by peakedness measurement, and embed kepoints feature into search branch adaptively. Our SiamKey can significantly reduce the background noise and improve the robustness without pre-fixed template size. Experiments on challenging benchmarks including VOT2018<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>, GOT-10k<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[2]</sup> and OTB-100<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[3]</sup>, demonstrate that the proposed SiamKey outperforms many state-of-the-art trackers.

articleTitle: Predicting Social Events using Entity Interaction Graph Sequences
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Focusing on the task of social event prediction, dynamic graph neural network (DGCN) gains good performance on real datasets. It proposes a context-based dynamic neural network for predicting events and generating a context graph for decision-making. Inspired by DGCN, this paper presents a model based on GDELT (Global Data on Event, Location and Tone) event database, using graph neural networks to model the entity interaction in the process before a target event. Our model overcomes deficiencies of weak relevance between keywords and events caused by context-based modeling. Based on realizing event prediction, the entity interaction graph is generated, which accurately depicts the interaction changes of a series of related entities before social events, making the generated entity interaction graph more conducive to narrative. The results show that the proposed model is effective on real datasets.

articleTitle: Combining I-vector and ResNet by Knowledge Distillation for Text-Independent Speaker Verification
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: For years, i-vector + PLDA model has dominated the text-independent Speaker Verification task. Until recently, Deep Neural Networks and metric-learning method becomes popular. In this paper, we combine these two methods by Knowledge Distillation. First, we propose our residual neural network based on ResNet34 which is trained with AM-Softmax loss. Then MSE loss between ResNet embedding and i-vector is used to do distillation. Experiments on VoxCeleb1 dataset shows that proposed ResNet can outperform widely used i-vector and x-vector method. With only MSE loss, ResNet has better performance than i-vector indicating its good generalization ability. After combining these two losses, the results can be further improved and show that distilling knowledge from i-vector can improve performance of the model with PLDA backend.

articleTitle: A Deep Neural Network Based Model For Jane Street Market Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The price trend of stocks directly affects the economic interests of investors, and also affects and reflects the country's macroeconomic policies, so it has received widespread attention. The formation and fluctuation of stock prices are not only restricted by various economic and political factors, but also influenced by investment psychology and trading techniques. But in fact, stock prices are not only closely related to the internal financial status of listed companies, but also related to the overall stock market conditions and even the overall economic operation. Due to the many factors that affect stock price fluctuations, using traditional regression analysis models to predict is not only complicated but also less accurate. In this paper, we propose an algorithm based on deep neural networks to build stock prediction models. This model is better than other models in predicting stock trends. Specifically, the return value of our neural network model is 3137 higher than the Xgboost algorithm and 4692 higher than the Lightgbm algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and verification of acceleration data recovery device during high-speed projectile entering water
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In the high-speed water impact experiment, we need to store and recover the acceleration data generated during the water impact. In response to this demand, we adopted a high anti-noise IEPE sensor, matched with the corresponding signal conditioning module, and used a 24-bit high-precision A/D conversion expansion board to develop an acceleration measurement device system plan. This scheme completes the layout and wiring of the entire collection device. Aiming at the power supply problem under high overload, we designed a power supply regulator IC and conducted an overload analysis. The data recovery device adopts a disconnection trigger scheme, which increases the reliability of the experiment. The software uses a double-cache storage solution, which uses less cache space to achieve data caching. The test results show that the measurement accuracy of the acceleration acquisition system is relatively high. Within the allowable error range, the acceleration acquisition device can provide basic data support for the acceleration analysis of the high-speed projectile in the water impact process, and can meet the needs of actual engineering.

articleTitle: Analysis of online shopping reviews based on natural language processing – Taking Amazon as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Based on the idea of natural language processing, a Naive Bayesian Model is established, and the scoring formula based on star rating and user evaluation is determined, so as to calculate the scores of all users. It is proved that the product has a life cycle, and the product popularity will decrease with the passage of time. The value model of products is established, and the products are clustered to get the value score of each product, so as to judge the success or failure of a product. Use python to count the frequency of each star's comments. We choose specific words and analyze the internal relationship between them and star rating. Finally, the strategies of consumer marketing refining, opening “technology +” mode and putting forward upgrading marketing effectiveness in the whole cycle.

articleTitle: Research on the Relationship between Regional Logistics Demand and Service Innovation based on Optimal Allocation of Factors in Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With China's accession to the WTO, China's logistics enterprises are facing great challenges in the context of digital economy. How to develop China's logistics has become the focus of many people. In the context of economic globalization, the key for enterprises to establish competitive advantage has shifted from the “first profit source” of raw material saving and the “second profit source” of improving labor productivity to the “third profit source” of establishing efficient logistics system. However, due to the shortage of resources and capabilities of Chinese logistics enterprises and their limitations in transportation, distribution, warehouse management and other fields, Chinese logistics enterprises compete with the same quality and have poor economies of scale. Under the current situation, only by changing the service mode of logistics enterprises and increasing service innovation can China's logistics industry be changed and developed.

articleTitle: Research on Performance of Sub-pixel Displacement Measurement Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: N-R algorithm, surface fitting algorithm, gradient algorithm and IC-GN algorithm are the main sub-pixel displacement measurement algorithms in digital image correlation method to improve the displacement measurement accuracy. In this paper, the simulation speckle pattern is generated by computer numerical simulation to carry out experiments, and the calculation accuracy and efficiency of the above four algorithms are compared. The results show that the N-R algorithm has the lowest calculation efficiency and the surface fitting method has the lowest calculation accuracy. The calculation efficiency and accuracy of gradient algorithm, IC-GN method are between N-R algorithm and surface fitting method, which is more suitable for engineering applications.

articleTitle: 2D Phase Unwrapping Based on U-Net and SVD for Fringe Projection Profilometry
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Phase unwrapping, a vital step with challenges in the Fringe Projection Profilometry (FPP), is directed to retrieve the origin phases from the wrapped phases to finish 3D reconstruction of objects. But Noise and spectrum aliasing from image capturing will lead to error diffusion in traditional phase unwrapping algorithms. This paper proposes a new, fast and robust 2D phase unwrapping method (called SVD-UNet) based on Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and semantic segmentation model U-Net. We equivalently convert the question of unwrapping phase into a classification issue of the order number of phase unwrapping. According to the features of the wrapped phase, it is easier for our method to obtain global information and improve the effect of semantic segmentation when taking the results of linear decomposition through SVD as the input of U-Net. The experimental results show that the new method has more stable performance, faster convergence speed and is more robust than the state-of-the-art.

articleTitle: A review of 5G applications and key technoligies
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet of Things technology in today's society, people's demand for communication is getting higher and higher. People need a convenient, smooth, and more advanced communication method. The previous communication network has failed to meet all human needs. To solve these problems, 5G came into being. In this article, the concept of 5G, the key technologies used by 5G, and the important role 5G plays in the Internet of Things are introduced in detail.

articleTitle: Research on the Measurement of Fatigue Crack Propagation Based on DCPD Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: This paper starts with the DCPD method, builds the DCPD crack growth test system hardware circuit, and carries on the system design on this basis. The DPCD measurement system was used to test and verify the crack growth of 316L under low cycle fatigue. The results show that the system is functionally stable and accurately on-line measuring the crack growth rate, and can be used in different corrosion environments.

articleTitle: Smart Management System for Hazardous Chemicals Park
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: This article has studied the technology and experience of the application of Internet of Things technology in the industrial chemical field in the past two years, combined with IOT, BIM, GIS and other technologies, and constructed a collection of data and processing through fuzzy evaluation method, AHP method and other evaluation methods Comprehensive management system for data to 3D display. This system solves the industry problem that the hazardous chemicals park lacks unified planning and management.

articleTitle: Towards prediction of Porous Silicon formation using Machine Learning models
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Porous Silicon (PS) is a spongy material with applications in semiconductor industry. The fabrication of PS in laboratory scale is time consuming and requires correct estimation of PS characteristics like porosity, pore size and thickness. Therefore, Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques like Machine Learning (ML) models are used to predict the characteristics accurately and within a short time. In this paper, I have used ML models for predicting the formation of porous silicon obtained from electrochemical anodization process from various sources. I have applied three ML models i.e., K Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Random Forest (RF), and Support Vector Machine (SVM) in the present study. The model is first trained by giving formation parameter values of Hydrofluoric acid (HF) concentration, type of Silicon wafer used (p or n type), current density (in mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), and the time required (in minutes) for the formation of pores as input. The training of the three models is done on a data set for the models to learn to predict the values of porosity, pore size, and thickness of the sample. I have performed the testing on a different dataset and the classification scores obtained for the three models are: 0.713 for SVM classifier, 0.693 for KNN and 0.68 for RF model. Further, the graphical comparisons between the actual and predicted values of PS characteristics have been presented using regression.

articleTitle: Big Data Knowledge Map Based on Entity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In order to directly and succinctly reflect the composition, dosage, processing and other information between traditional Chinese medicine, as well as the common relationship between traditional Chinese medicine and traditional Chinese medicine, this project collected and processed a large number of traditional Chinese medicine data, through the construction of knowledge map of traditional Chinese medicine, Chinese medicine workers intuitively display the composition of traditional Chinese medicine information, Chinese medicine between direct or indirect related information, so as to facilitate a deep understanding of the hidden knowledge of traditional Chinese medicine information; The project takes the prescription in the information of traditional Chinese medicine as the main research body, studies the composition of the prescription of traditional Chinese medicine and other relevant information, and shows the correlation between the prescription itself, the composition of traditional Chinese medicine, the prescription and the prescription, the prescription and the medicine in this intuitive and concise way, so that more people can understand the prescription and understand the traditional Chinese medicine. The public can easily obtain relevant knowledge of traditional Chinese medicine according to their own situation. The above two aspects have played an important role in human health and promoted the inheritance and promotion of traditional Chinese medicine.

Author Keywords: TCM prescription knowledge map big data

articleTitle: Joint Extraction Model of Entity and Relationship Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In this paper, an entity relationship association extraction model based on reinforcement learning is proposed, namely, the sequence labeling Association model. It is used to solve the tag noise caused by the entity relationship extraction method based on remote monitoring. The model consists of two modules: sentence picker module and entity relation joint extraction module. First, the sentence picker module selects high-quality sentences with no data noise. Joint entity relationship extraction module will then selected sentences as its input and sequence annotation decoding method to forecast the input sentence and the sentence selected modules provide reward and guidance sentences selected sentences of choice high quality, and adopted a special label scheme combined extraction task is converted into a sequence labeling problem. Finally, the combination model of sequence annotation is trained to optimize sentence selection and sequence annotation together. The experimental results show that the sentence picker can effectively deal with the noise of the data, and the combination model of sequence annotation can effectively improve the F1 value of the sequence annotation model.

articleTitle: Delay propagation evaluation of flight chain model based on big data visual analytics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: By analyzing the historical data of flight delay, the delay problem can be effectively prevented and controlled. The spread of delay propagation in continuous flights often leads to large-scale flight delays. Aiming at the problems of flight delay propagation, a flight chain model is proposed to evaluate flight delays. Because flight data has the characteristics of time and space, the flight delay visualization analytics system is put forward to directly interpret the spatio-temporal pattern of flight delay. The time-varying delay trend is shown by the time line chart and sequence histogram. At the same time, it analysis the time sequence of the impact of flight delays on the consecutive flights through the thermal sequence diagram of flight and parallel coordinate chart. The spatial model reflects the spatial distribution rule and spatial clustering results of delay in airports in different regions by thermal map and rectangular tree diagram. Simultaneously, through the tree diagram of flight propagation delay from the perspective of spatial spread, the delay sweep problems are intuitively analyzed. According to the results of the delay spread assessment and visualization, it can provide corresponding suggestions for various departments to control the delay propagation.

articleTitle: Design of Convolution Neural Network Accelerator Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In this paper, aiming at the embedded and realtime target detection platform, from the perspective of highspeed hardware implementation, the target detection algorithm based on Mobilenet-SSD is analyzed. The CNN accelerator based on FPGA is designed, using hardware optimization techniques such as parallel, pipelining and double buffering. The function verification and performance test are carried out on GVI Cxz7100 development board. The test results show that the design function is correct, and the processing speed is better than that of PC.

articleTitle: Space Planning of Mobile Robot Guided by Path Edge
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The visual navigation mobile robot is greatly influenced by environmental parameters, which leads to poor optimization control ability of the robot. In order to improve the stability of the spatial planning of the mobile robot, a guidance algorithm for the spatial planning of the visual navigation mobile robot based on path edge guidance is proposed. The parameter distribution model of spatial distribution of moving path of visual navigation mobile robot is constructed, and the constraint parameters of spatial path planning adjustment of visual navigation mobile robot are analyzed. The steady-state control problem of spatial path planning adjustment of visual navigation mobile robot is transformed into the optimization problem of path edge guidance parameters, which effectively realizes the transformation of moving path characteristics and error compensation correction of path guidance of visual navigation mobile robot. Combined with the motion planning model, the robot spatial behavior path is driven, and the spatial path planning and behavior characteristics steady-state adaptive control of the visual navigation mobile robot are completed. The simulation results show that the path space planning control of visual navigation mobile robot has good stability and superior adaptive control performance, which improves the adaptive control and parameter optimization adjustment ability of visual navigation mobile robot.

articleTitle: Research on Enhancing Generalization Ability of Question Answering System by Retelling Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Retelling generation technology has important applications in many aspects, such as: in question answering system, it can be used to improve the system’s ability to understand questions and optimize the system performance; With the continuous development and maturity of various underlying technologies of natural language processing, it is possible to study retelling, which has attracted more and more attention. In this paper, a method of generating retelling questions based on template matching is proposed, which can effectively preserve the structural and semantic features of questions. Introducing functional tags to highlight the structural features of questions; The introduction of dependency relationship improves the generalization performance of question template; By introducing candidate sorting, the accuracy of the generated results is greatly improved. As the retelling technique mainly operates on monolingual language, it is possible to use large-scale monolingual language data to generate retelling, thus alleviating the problem of insufficient bilingual language data to a certain extent.
